relationships.subject: Baicalin
relationships.evidence_quote: Results indicated Baicalin, Butrin, Dihydromonospermoside, Icariin, Isocoreopsin and Isosaponarin are showing promising docking score with sodium activated voltage channel 1.7 than other compounds.

key_findings: In silico docking identifies several flavonoids/polyphenols with promising docking scores against Nav1.7.
